01

Schema has invalid prices and Friday hours

24 treatment Product nodes contain invalid $$$ offers, and the shared Dentist schema closes Friday at noon instead of the published 1 PM.

  • Remove the offers subnode from those 24 Product nodes, not the entire Product or other schema.
  • Change Friday's Dentist schema hours from 09:00–12:00 to 09:00–13:00; leave the correct visible hours and GBP unchanged.
02

The desktop hero moves during loading

Desktop Google lab CLS is 0.565, concentrated in the welcome-video column, with Newsreader font changes flagged as contributors and no reserved video aspect ratio.

  • Reserve the video wrapper's 16:9 space in first-load CSS and use stable font fallbacks with only needed Geist/Newsreader weights.
  • Retest the desktop hero after each change; mobile lab CLS was 0, so this is not a proven mobile shifting problem.
03

An implant guide links to a missing article

The affordable-implants guide links twice to an All-on-4 URL returning HTTP 404, while the same article exists at the plural implants URL.

  • Replace both source links with the live article URL.
  • Add the exact 301 below for old visitors; do not redirect unrelated pages to the homepage.

04

An Invisalign link leads to ClearCorrect

The clear-aligners page labels a link Invisalign treatment, but its /invisalign/ destination has a ClearCorrect title, heading and copy.

  • Proposed: change the source anchor to ClearCorrect treatment and link directly to the current ClearCorrect page at /cosmetic-dentistry/invisalign/.
  • Keep the existing URL; no separate Invisalign service page was found in the checked inventory, and the Invisalign blog is not a treatment-page substitute.
05

Recent Posts page buttons loop back

All 76 article templates show Recent Posts page buttons whose post-relative links redirect back to the same article instead of showing more posts.

  • Remove the numbered controls from the single-article Recent Posts component and add a View all posts link to /blog/.
  • Keep a short set of useful article links; the rendered Blog archive already exposes all 76 posts, so no mass redirects or new menu items are needed.

Fix order

Fix schema and broken journeys, then stabilize the desktop hero and correct the aligner link wording.

  • Website: invalid offers and Friday schema, All-on-4 links/redirect, desktop video space/fonts and Recent Posts controls.
  • Content: proposed ClearCorrect anchor and direct destination; no poster compression or URL rename.

Read-only October 2 evidence; drafts only, no website changes or tickets created. Schema findings combined; poster compression excluded at the user's request. Speed results are lab-only; real-user Core Web Vitals were unavailable. Clinical claims, backlinks and geography-related booking errors are excluded.
